message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: Cloud recordings: cloud.reolink.com or Reolink App → Cloud Library → Select files to download → choose clips, one (or a few) at a time. Local/NVR recordings: on-device Menu → Search → Backup → select all channels + date range → Start, to a USB drive as MP4/H.265. NVR-only config: Menu → System → Maintenance → Export/Import → Export, to a config file.

Please place these files in a folder named Reolink!
notes: Cloud clips download one or a few at a time; there is no bulk cloud export.
Local/NVR backup goes through a USB drive as MP4/H.265.
